answer: Each identity registers an ocean watch-station, stakes 80, and files a key-signed comet sighting log in the apparition window: serial, tail angle, zephyr cloud cover. Auditors match it against the comet ephemeris for that ocean sector and the zephyr weather record; late, wrong-angle, reused, or missing filings burn the bond. First filing 38, the k-th 38+9(k-1), the 1000th 9029, 1000 fakes cost 4,533,500 plus 80,000 locked. A rented-station ring fails: one station serves one sector per apparition, so a duplicate serial burns both. An honest watcher pays 38 once, bond back after a clean audit.
